svg.title: Setting up TaskGraph
svg.desc: Running taskgraph init in ~/my-app: it asks where to keep tasks, whether to set up Claude Code and which models to use, sets up .taskgraph/ and CLAUDE.md, and lists the next steps.

g.text: Set it up in your project
Store tasks in Git (tasks.json and tasks/ directory)?
Fallback model (used if the main model fails)
Git merges tasks.json by task; commit it
loads TaskGraph's instructions in Claude Code
1. Add the slash commands in Claude Code:
AI runs through Claude Code; run
